INSERT INTO TRADE ( TRADE_ID, MEMBER_ID, STOCK_NAME, STOCK_CODE, BUY_DATE, SELL_DATE, BUY_PRICE, SELL_PRICE, QUANTITY, BUY_REASON, REVIEW ) VALUES ( #{tradeId}, #{memberId}, #{stockName}, #{stockCode}, #{buyDate}, #{sellDate}, #{buyPrice}, #{sellPrice}, #{quantity}, #{buyReason}, #{review} )
mapper.select:
SELECT T.*,
COUNT(TRC.RULE_ID) AS TOTAL_RULE_COUNT,
SUM( CASE WHEN TRC.FOLLOWED = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS FOLLOWED_RULE_COUNT
FROM TRADE T
LEFT JOIN TRADE_RULE_CHECK TRC ON T.TRADE_ID = TRC.TRADE_ID
WHERE T.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
GROUP BY T.TRADE_ID, T.MEMBER_ID, T.STOCK_NAME, T.STOCK_CODE, T.BUY_DATE, T.SELL_DATE, T.BUY_PRICE, T.SELL_PRICE, T.QUANTITY, T.BUY_REASON, T.REVIEW, T.CREATED_AT, T.UPDATED_AT
ORDER BY T.TRADE_ID DESC
FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY
mapper.update: UPDATE TRADE SET STOCK_NAME = #{stockName}, STOCK_CODE = #{stockCode}, BUY_DATE = #{buyDate}, SELL_DATE = #{sellDate}, BUY_PRICE = #{buyPrice}, SELL_PRICE = #{sellPrice}, QUANTITY = #{quantity}, BUY_REASON = #{buyReason}, REVIEW = #{review}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE TRADE_ID = #{tradeId} AND MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
mapper.select: SELECT NVL( SUM( CASE WHEN SELL_PRICE > BUY_PRICE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) / COUNT(*) * 100, 0 ) FROM TRADE WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
SELECT NVL( SUM( CASE WHEN TRC.FOLLOWED = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) / COUNT(*) * 100, 0 ) FROM TRADE_RULE_CHECK TRC JOIN TRADE T ON TRC.TRADE_ID = T.TRADE_ID WHERE T.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}

SELECT STOCK_NAME, STOCK_CODE,
COUNT(*) AS TRADE_COUNT,
NVL( SUM( CASE WHEN SELL_PRICE > BUY_PRICE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) / COUNT(*) * 100, 0 ) AS WIN_RATE,
NVL( AVG( (SELL_PRICE - BUY_PRICE) / BUY_PRICE * 100 ), 0 ) AS AVERAGE_RETURN_RATE,
NVL( SUM( (SELL_PRICE - BUY_PRICE) * QUANTITY ), 0 ) AS TOTAL_PROFIT
FROM TRADE
WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
GROUP BY STOCK_NAME, STOCK_CODE
ORDER BY TOTAL_PROFIT DESC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT TO_CHAR(SELL_DATE, 'YYYY-MM') AS TRADE_MONTH,
COUNT(*) AS TRADE_COUNT,
NVL( SUM( CASE WHEN SELL_PRICE > BUY_PRICE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) / COUNT(*) * 100, 0 ) AS WIN_RATE,
NVL( AVG( (SELL_PRICE - BUY_PRICE) / BUY_PRICE * 100 ), 0 ) AS AVERAGE_RETURN_RATE,
NVL( SUM( (SELL_PRICE - BUY_PRICE) * QUANTITY ), 0 ) AS TOTAL_PROFIT
FROM TRADE
WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND SELL_DATE IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY TO_CHAR(SELL_DATE, 'YYYY-MM')
ORDER BY TRADE_MONTH DESC )
WHERE ROWNUM <= 5
ORDER BY TRADE_MONTH ASC

SELECT TRADE_ID, MEMBER_ID, STOCK_NAME, STOCK_CODE, BUY_DATE, SELL_DATE, BUY_PRICE, SELL_PRICE, QUANTITY, BUY_REASON, REVIEW, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT
FROM TRADE
WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
AND STOCK_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
AND SELL_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND SELL_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
ORDER BY SELL_DATE ASC, TRADE_ID ASC
ORDER BY (SELL_PRICE - BUY_PRICE) / BUY_PRICE DESC
ORDER BY (SELL_PRICE - BUY_PRICE) / BUY_PRICE ASC
ORDER BY SELL_DATE DESC, TRADE_ID DESC
OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{pageSize} ROWS ONLY

FROM TRADE

AND STOCK_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'

AND SELL_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
